files.description: BookStack HTML export of the single EHI export documentation page. Contains full page content including embedded image of data dictionary table. Primary artifact.
BookStack PDF export of the EHI export documentation page. 4-page PDF generated by dompdf. Data dictionary table is rendered as image (not extractable as text).
BookStack Markdown export of the EHI export documentation page. Contains full text content; data dictionary table referenced as image link rather than markdown table.

PNG image of the data dictionary table listing 17 fields included in the C-CDA export (patient_name, dob, gender, race, ethnicity, language, address, phone, emergency_contact, smoking_status, problem_list, medications, allergies, lab_results, procedures, encounters, vital_signs). This is the only data dictionary provided — it is an image, not structured data.

Full-page browser screenshot of the BookStack documentation page, showing the complete layout including page navigation sidebar, data dictionary image, JSON response examples, and download instructions.
